title: A computer-assisted counterexample to the planar Berenstein conjecture
summary: Recent work of Colbrook and Stepaniants produced the first counterexamples to the planar Pompeiu and Schiffer conjectures and introduced the conformal fixed-disc, disk-polynomial, and validated-tail machinery used here. By adapting this framework to the complementary Dirichlet endpoint, we disprove the unrestricted planar Berenstein conjecture.
